title: Stable API, English strings, layered CSS, ThemeOptions

entries.note: `BrandPreset` was removed from the exports. `brandPresetCSS` output changed (theme islands) and the head style id is `ca-theme` (was `ca-brand-presets`).
`ThemeOptions` is now `Partial<ThemeDefinition>`. Move custom tokens into `overrides` and brand colors into `presets`; there is no mechanical rewrite.

entries.selector: default UI strings (label, placeholder, confirmLabel, emptyText...)
entries.replacement: catalog strings; setLocale("pt-BR") once in the root layout
entries.note: Defaults are English from a typed catalog (en, pt-BR). Portuguese apps call setLocale once; text props no longer have hardcoded defaults: omit them to use the catalog.

entries.replacement: @layer ca.reset, ca.tokens, ca.themes, ca.base, ca.components, ca.materials, ca.utilities
entries.note: The kit CSS is layered, so unlayered app CSS wins without !important. Delete `!important` and doubled-class overrides you added to beat the kit. Override a token by declaring `--ca-*` on `:root`.

entries.replacement: html paints --ca-surface-base, mesh on body::before, opaque --ca-chrome-surface
entries.note: `body` is transparent now. MobileHeader and BottomNav are opaque so the browser status bar and toolbar match them.

entries.replacement: primeKeyboard() in the opening tap, or { touch: true }; responsive width is undefined until init()
entries.note: `autofocus` on touch devices only focuses when the keyboard was primed in the opening tap. `responsive` has an undefined width until `init()` runs; derived values treat it as desktop.

entries.replacement: nothing: every text field is 16px globally
entries.note: Delete the class from your markup; the global 16px minimum covers every text field.
